description: Extrude a sketch as a cut (op=REMOVE). Sketch a circle first, then cut it through the body: end_type THROUGH_ALL needs no depth. A sketch on a body's face points out of the body, so pass opposite to cut into it.

depth.description: Cut depth in inches; the total depth when symmetric. Required unless THROUGH_ALL or depth_variable.

depth_variable.description: Use a Part Studio variable for the depth.

elem.description: Element id (tab) — the <elem> segment of the document URL.

end_type.description: BLIND goes `depth` along the sketch normal (default); SYMMETRIC goes `depth` in total, half each side of the sketch plane; THROUGH_ALL goes past every body and ignores `depth`.

name.description: Feature name shown in the tree (default "Hole").

opposite.description: Go against the sketch normal instead of along it. Not with SYMMETRIC.

sketch.description: Feature id of the sketch to cut with.

validate.description: Re-read the feature list afterwards and fail if the feature regenerated with an error (default true).

ws.description: Workspace id — the <ws> segment of the document URL.

name: onshape_hole
title: Cut a hole
